recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-13815 unless the Vocabulary work group chooses to undertake a broader terminology-documentation rewrite outside this issue.
issue_request: FHIR-13815 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for STU3. It requested clearer documentation of the purpose of ValueSet, especially that a ValueSet is not used as a Coding.system and is instead used for binding/validation and other context-specific code selection while CodeSystem defines code meaning.
initial_application: The issue was explicitly applied by SVN revision 13457, mirrored as git commit 5330c3c2ad49a97722ab121f48296c2c34e4f890, which updated source/datatypes.html and source/terminologies.html with the requested CodeSystem-vs-ValueSet distinction. Later editorial refactors preserved the substantive wording.
additional_context: The originating Zulip thread shows the exact implementer confusion that led to the issue: a Patient.marital-status Coding used a ValueSet URL as system. Current source also includes ValueSet resource documentation describing codes from one or more code systems intended for a particular context and documents ValueSet.useContext. Related issues FHIR-16379 and FHIR-16497 were encountered in history but are already represented on the combined reconciliation branch.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was made because the active Coding, Using Codes in Resources, and ValueSet StructureDefinition source already satisfy the applied Jira request.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive with Modification issue requesting clearer documentation of ValueSet purpose and the CodeSystem-vs-ValueSet distinction.
evidence_items.learned: The final requested change was documentation in Coding, Using Codes in Resources, and, if possible, ValueSet resource context-of-use wording.

evidence_items.summary: The originating thread describes an implementer using a ValueSet as Coding.system and agreeing the documentation should be clearer.
evidence_items.learned: The intended clarification is specifically that system identifies a code system, while a value set supplies context-specific allowable codes.

evidence_items.summary: GF#13815 / SVN r13457 updated datatypes.html and terminologies.html to clarify value sets and code systems.
evidence_items.learned: The seed was explicitly applied in source history and the current wording descends from that application.

evidence_items.summary: Coding.system identifies the code system defining the code and SHALL NOT reference a ValueSet.url because value sets define contextual code sets, not meanings.
evidence_items.learned: Coding already contains the core requested clarification.

evidence_items.summary: Using Codes in Resources distinguishes code systems, value sets, bindings, and system URLs.
evidence_items.learned: The terminology guidance already explains the requested distinction for implementers.

evidence_items.summary: ValueSet is defined as codes from code systems for a particular context, and useContext documents supported contexts.
evidence_items.learned: The current ValueSet resource documentation includes the requested context-of-use notion.

evidence_items.summary: FHIR build configuration lists ValueSet as an active resource, assigns it to vocab, marks Coding normative, and includes the ValueSet work-group code.
